title: Real B1.10 Temporal Characterization Readiness
target: Qualify the prerequisites and fail-closed boundary for reproducible source-bound B1.10 full-step versus two-half-step temporal characterization from one committed physical state.
non_goals: invent or tune per-metric temporal tolerances
qualify a complete optional-process temporal profile
change SWAP physics, solver policy, timestep policy or mass tolerances
reinterpret deterministic contract-test values as production evidence
hard_constraints: hard mass conservation remains a separate non-delegable gate
solver convergence tolerances cannot substitute for temporal-accuracy limits
all compared endpoints must refer to the same physical t1 and the same committed starting state
optional process state must be explicitly covered before complete-process temporal qualification
unavailable real execution assets remain fail-closed rather than being replaced by synthetic physics
